findings.title: Gate-9 negation leg greens on ANY non-zero exit, not only the claimed usage exit 2
findings.detail: The comment contracts 'rejected (usage exit 2)' but `! ./bin/harness input-parity bogus` accepts any non-zero exit — a crash on the arg path false-greens. The [ -x ] guard correctly kills the 127 class, and harness usage() does exit 2 today (main.odin:230). The fold's letter is satisfied; this is hardening of a negative-control pin.
findings.recommended_fix: Capture and assert the exact code: ./bin/harness input-parity bogus >/dev/null 2>&1; rc=$?; [ $rc -eq 2 ]

findings.title: Demolish-while-placing / mid-drag inertness (executor gate exec.odin:146) has no scripted pin — deleting it passes all 24 scenarios
findings.detail: AC#1 claims demolish is DISABLED while placing/mid-drag; the gate exists and matches the old code's semantics, but no scenario presses X/DEL (keyboard or pad) in either state, so a regression of the gate is invisible. Same class as 5.4's W1-r4 (folded forward as a warning).
findings.recommended_fix: Add a parity scenario: arm placement (and a mid-drag leg), press X on mouse+pad, assert zero commands and intact selection.

findings.title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
findings.detail: P0 fully covered (the two new positive pins bite — Perkins mutation-verified); P1 ~85-89%: the mirror terminal-clear leg and the placing/mid-drag inertness gate are unpinned. Roll-up of findings 2 and 4.
findings.recommended_fix: Land the two pins in findings 2 and 4 to raise the gate to PASS.

findings.title: Node_Select mirror's terminal→clear branch (E2 mirror) is pinned by no scenario
findings.detail: A mutated mirror that SELECTS terminals passes all 24 scenarios: scenario 23's pad leg ends on the junction (sel_node=1 either way), pad_cursor_wrap parks on terminal node 0 but asserts pad_node only. The story-card 'terminal → clear' leg has no final-state assert.
findings.recommended_fix: Assert sel_node == -1 with the pad cursor parked on a terminal (pad_cursor_wrap already ends there).

findings.title: pipe_demolish_btn_center re-derives the midpoint anchor math the diff's own N2-r4 fold single-sourced
findings.detail: A third copy of the anchor formula, from fixture constants; build_scenarios holds no topology to delegate with. Drift fails loudly (the press misses the button), so maintainability debt, not correctness.
findings.recommended_fix: Optional: plumb the fixture topology through and delegate to rnd.pipe_anchor(view, topo, 0).

findings.title: Every dpad step forces sel_pipe = -1 — a mouse/touch pipe selection dies on any pad nudge (mixed input)
findings.detail: Both mirror branches clear sel_pipe unconditionally. Consistent with click_select's exclusivity and the 'dpad cursor IS the pad's select' design, but the cross-device side effect (QoS panel/popover closing mid-mouse-session on an incidental pad touch) is not flagged in the diff or decision log.
findings.recommended_fix: Document the mixed-input interaction in the decision log, or only mirror over pad-owned selections.

findings.title: The 'swallowed — no re-select' release frames in scenarios 23/24 are vacuous
findings.detail: Post-demolish the button center is ~250px+ from the nearest live node (snap_radius 36) and the pipe is dead, so a dropped press_swallowed latch re-selects nothing and the final-state asserts stay green. Verified against fixture geometry (nodes 12 tiles apart).
findings.recommended_fix: Add a follow-up release on a LIVE node so a dropped swallow latch changes the final selection and trips an assert.

findings.title: poll.odin RIGHT_FACE_LEFT → .X raylib adapter is never exercised by any test
findings.detail: By design (harness header: parity scripts semantic Pad_Button_Press, never the poll adapters); a swapped physical constant ships untested. Documented blind spot, same class as the other 5.4 adapters.
findings.recommended_fix: Optional: a tiny @(test) over pad_map, or record the blind spot in the harness header (already documented).

findings.title: Node_Select mirror re-implements click_select's junction/terminal selection rule
findings.detail: The junction→select / else→clear rule now lives in two places; the mirror's own comment names click_select's rule. Small, but against the repo's ONE-copy discipline.
findings.recommended_fix: Extract a shared select_node/clear_selection helper called from both.

findings.title: ui_hook wiring by scenario-name string matching (three scattered sites per scenario)
findings.detail: Hook selection + check_states both key on name strings; a rename silently drops the wired hook (for esc_ui, weakening the negative pin without failing).
findings.recommended_fix: Add a declarative hook field to Parity_Scenario set at the scenario site.
